-- Calculate avg annual goals per patient, then average by diagnosis
WITH patient_goals AS (
    SELECT 
        ab.pat_owner_ref,
        asd.prim_dx,
        AVG(CAST(SPLIT_PART(ab.recovery_goal_vel, ' ', 1) AS numeric)) * 12 as patient_annual_goals
    FROM assessmentbasics ab
    JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON ab.ab_key = asd.asd_key 
    WHERE asd.prim_dx IN ('PTSD', 'Anxiety')
    GROUP BY ab.pat_owner_ref, asd.prim_dx
)
SELECT 
    prim_dx,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(patient_annual_goals) AS numeric), 2) as avg_yearly_goal_achievement
FROM patient_goals
GROUP BY prim_dx;

)
